summary: Verified the iter264 UI/UX punchlist for the subscription view-only gating on BOTH web and mobile against the shared backend. WEB PaywallModal: heading is state-agnostic 'Your Wayly plan is inactive' (regression from 'free trial has ended' fixed); Solo card shows '1 Participant tracked' + '1 Caregiver seat'; Family card shows '2 Participants tracked' + 'Up to 5 Caregiver seats'; paywall-cta-solo AND paywall-cta-family POST /api/payments/checkout (trial_days:0) and redirect straight to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... — no /settings/billing detour; paywall-dismiss (X) and paywall-keep-viewing both close the modal, and it REAPPEARS on the next wayly:trial-expired event (i.e., next page load). MOBILE ViewOnlyBanner: Reactivate button is a white pill (rgb 255,255,255) with dark navy text (rgb 28,43,45) — verified via getComputedStyle — high contrast in BOTH light and dark themes (was invisible white-on-white before); tapping Reactivate routes to /plan-select; view-only-banner-dismiss present. MOBILE plan-select: plan cards render plan-participants-{solo,family} and plan-seats-{solo,family} with the correct copy (Family shows 'UP TO 5 CAREGIVER SEATS'). BACKEND: 9/9 focused paywall/checkout tests pass (test_paywall_checkout_iter264.py) — cancelled.vo access_state=view_only, POST /api/payments/checkout returns checkout.stripe.com URL for both solo and family with trial_days:0, /api/billing/portal and /api/auth/me remain reachable for view_only, non-billing writes (/participant/wellbeing) still 402 with read_only payload. Enforcement of view_only writes returning 402 remains intact (regression clean vs iter263).
critical_code_review_comments: PaywallModal.jsx:65-84 onUpgrade calls POST /payments/checkout with trial_days:0 and navigates window.location.href to data.url — verified in browser: destination is checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (NOT /settings/billing). Solid.
PaywallModal.jsx:118-120 heading is now state-agnostic ('Your Wayly plan is inactive') — matches spec. No stale 'free trial has ended' copy anywhere in the modal.

ViewOnlyBanner.tsx:73-79 hard-codes the pill as backgroundColor:'#FFFFFF' with color:'#1C2B2D' — bypasses theme.text (which was #FFFFFF in dark, hence white-on-white). Best-practice would be to introduce a theme token like colors.onGoldPill instead of hard-coded hex, but this fix is safe and correct.

EmailVerifyBanner.tsx:88-93 hides dismiss when status.past_deadline is true; resend Pressable spans full row regardless — non-dismissible past-deadline requirement is met by construction. Runtime past_deadline verification with available fixture (cancelled.vo has 5 days remaining) wasn't possible; code review confirms correctness.

ai-tools.tsx:69-94 renders ai-tools-locked-notice ONLY when viewOnly && !lockDismissed — locked-reactivate and locked-dismiss testIDs present; Reactivate routes to /plan-select. Could not exercise at runtime because the view-only test user was routed into /onboarding on tab entry (household not yet created); not a regression of this iteration.

plans.ts:34 Family participants string reads '2 Participants' (not '2 Participants tracked' — Solo uses 'tracked'). Spec allows either since the badge is derived from `participants` field; low priority copy inconsistency between Solo/Family badges.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression asset: /app/backend/tests/test_paywall_checkout_iter264.py verifies POST /api/payments/checkout returns a real checkout.stripe.com URL for view_only user with trial_days:0 on both plans. iter263 regression file (/app/backend/tests/test_view_only_enforcement_iter263.py) still valid. Mobile Expo web preview login works via input[type=email] + input[type=password] + get_by_text('Sign In'). Two limitations to note for future iterations: (1) EmailVerifyBanner past_deadline path needs a fixture user with verification_deadline in the past (cancelled.vo has 5 days remaining); (2) ai-tools-locked-notice runtime test needs a view_only user that has completed onboarding — otherwise navigating to /(tabs)/ai-tools routes to /onboarding.
